items.title: What Is KKR (KKR) Signaling With A $9 Billion Energy Bid And India Bet?
items.summary: KKR (NYSE: KKR) has submitted a US$9b bid to acquire U.S. energy distributor UGI, according to people familiar with the matter. The proposed UGI deal would expand KKR's exposure to U.S. energy infrastructure at a time of rising electricity demand from AI data centers. Separately, KKR has taken a minority stake in Indian ticketing and events platform BookMyShow, increasing its activity in India's live entertainment market.
